title: Optical and magneto-optical behavior of Cerium Yttrium Iron Garnet thin films at wavelengths of 200–1770 nm
source_description: Unmodified authors supplementary dataset. Raw fitted complex tensor values may violate passivity at low absorption. Do not silently clip. See article Methods and Eq. (1).
tensor_convention: Publication Eq. (1): epsilon_xy = -i epsilon2; epsilon_yx = +i epsilon2. Repo epsilon_xy = +i g for m_z=+1, hence g=-epsilon2 if using same harmonic convention. Source diagonal imaginary parts are positive for loss; paper prose does not state harmonic convention explicitly.
